---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or diagnostic for Device Intelligence
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of what problem this feature would solve.
Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternative Solutions
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Diagnostic Category
Which category would this feature belong to?
- [ ] Overview
- [ ] Browser
- [ ] System
- [ ] Display
- [ ] CPU & Memory
- [ ] Graphics
- [ ] Audio
- [ ] Camera & Microphone
- [ ] Network
- [ ] Storage
- [ ] Battery
- [ ] Sensors
- [ ] Input
- [ ] Gamepads
- [ ] Connectivity
- [ ] Permissions
- [ ] Web APIs
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Privacy
- [ ] Performance
- [ ] Reports
- [ ] New category (please specify)

## Web API Reference
If this feature involves a specific Web API, please provide:
- API name: [e.g. WebGPU, File System Access API]
- MDN link: [e.g. https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/...]
- Browser support: [e.g. Chrome 113+, Firefox 121+, Safari 17+]

## Privacy Considerations
Does this feature involve:
- [ ] Reading sensitive data (camera, microphone, location)
- [ ] Requesting browser permissions
- [ ] Accessing hardware information
- [ ] Network requests

If yes, please explain how privacy will be maintained.

## Use Case
Describe the use case for this feature. Who would benefit from it and how?

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.

## Checklist
- [ ] I have searched existing issues to avoid duplicates
- [ ] I have checked the Web API is available in modern browsers
- [ ] I have considered privacy implications
- [ ] I have described the use case clearly
